entities.name: Abd-Allah ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥanafiyya, also known as Abū Hāshim was a member of the Banu Hashim clan of the Quraish tribe in Mecca. He was one of the Salaf and a narrator of hadith.
